The official Firecrawl pricing page gives the Hobby plan as 5,000 credits per month, at $19/month or $16/month billed annually. Hobby: 5,000 credits per month, $19/month or $16/month billed annually ($190/year). Hobby credits do not carry over to the next month, per the same page: Hobby, Standard and Growth credits do not roll over.

Pay-as-you-go is available on paid plans. A 5 USD increment is 1,000 credits on Hobby. The billing docs also list a small overage allowance on Hobby of 1,500 credits, which covers bursts while a top-up settles.

Third-party blogs repeat the 5,000-credit figure, though some quote different prices. One Firecrawl-published comparison says the $29/mo Hobby plan strips out JS rendering and geo-targeting, which conflicts with the official $19 price. The official pricing page is the most reliable source here, and it may have changed since these blogs were written.
